name: Case Study Generator
description: Per-call case-study drafter, as an Attention agent-builder flow. Fires once per analyzed success call, drafts a structured case study from the call (and your CRM facts), and DMs it to the marketing owner as a DRAFT for review. It never publishes and never contacts the customer. On import, set the connections and the placeholder ids (<...>). Schema matches Attention's agent builder (Activepieces); on a different platform use case-study-generator.md.

trigger.name: trigger
trigger.displayName: When one of my calls is analyzed

nextAction.name: draft_case_study
nextAction.displayName: Draft the case study from THIS call (DRAFT for review)

input.prompt: You are the Case Study Generator agent, working from THIS call (title: {{trigger.attributes.title}}). First confirm this is a success story (strong positive outcome, measurable result, satisfied customer, or a closed-won deal). If it is NOT, output exactly: 'Not a success story - no case study drafted.' and stop. If it is, extract from the conversation: the customer's stated challenge, what they adopted and why, the results they reported with any metric, and the most quotable moments verbatim. Then draft a structured case study. Return plain text EXACTLY as: 'Title: ...' then 'Client Overview: ...' then 'Challenge: ...' then 'Solution: ...' then 'Results: ...' then 'Customer Quote: "..."' then 'Why it matters: ...' then '---' then 'Review checklist:' listing the source call, any quotes that need customer approval before publication, and any fact you could not verify from the call (e.g. deal value - confirm in CRM). Do not invent numbers, quotes, or outcomes the call did not support. Apply these humanizer rules: no em dashes, no 'I hope this finds you well' or 'I wanted to reach out', no hype adjectives. This is a DRAFT for the marketing team to review; never publish and never address the customer.

nextAction.name: send_draft_dm
nextAction.displayName: DM the draft to the marketing owner (never publish, never the customer)

input.text:
:memo: *Draft case study* from {{trigger.attributes.title}} -- review, fact-check, and get quote approval before publishing:

{{draft_case_study.output}}
